rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be 18 or over to request a Carer's Assessment. Young carers (under 18) should request a Young Carer's Assessment instead.

rules.description: Applicant must be providing care to another person
rules.reason_if_failed: You need to be caring for someone to request a Carer's Assessment. This service is for unpaid carers only.

rules.description: Applicant must reside in the local authority's jurisdiction
rules.reason_if_failed: You need to apply to the local authority where you live. We'll help you find the right council.

rules.description: Applicant must be providing or intending to provide substantial care
rules.reason_if_failed: Please provide information about the care you provide to help us assess your needs

edge_cases.description: Carer reports being in crisis or at breaking point
edge_cases.action: Urgent priority assessment required. Route to emergency social care team within 24 hours. Provide crisis support contact details.

edge_cases.description: Information suggests safeguarding risk to carer or cared-for person
edge_cases.action: Immediate handoff to safeguarding team. Do not proceed with standard assessment. Contact social services duty team.

edge_cases.description: Person being cared for also needs or has never had a needs assessment
edge_cases.action: Offer combined assessment. Route to adult social care team to coordinate both assessments simultaneously.

edge_cases.description: Multiple carers caring for the same person
edge_cases.action: Each carer entitled to separate assessment. Coordinate assessments and support plans to avoid duplication.

edge_cases.description: Carer is employed and needs assessment outside working hours
edge_cases.action: Offer flexible appointment times. Consider telephone or video assessment options.
